title: stipa occidentalis var. montana
intro: Stipa occidentalis var. montana, commonly known as Mountain Bunchgrass, is a type of perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of western North America. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and calming nervous anxiety. The health benefits of Mountain Bunchgrass are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, further research is needed to fully understand the scope of its therapeutic potential and its effects on human health.
